FOCTuner reads and changes the settings of VESC-based motor controllers, runs motor detection, drives motors for testing, updates firmware and shows live data. Many of these actions take effect on the controller immediately.

A motor controller switches large currents from a battery that can deliver a lot of energy very quickly. Wrong settings, a failed detection or a firmware problem can make a motor start, run away or brake hard without warning, and can destroy the controller, the motor or the battery, or start a fire.\n\nBefore detection or any motor test, lift the drive wheel or remove the belt or propeller, keep hands, hair and clothing away from moving parts, and make sure nobody rides or holds the vehicle. Start with low current limits, check every value before writing it, and keep a way to cut power within reach. Never change settings while riding. STOP releases the motors and blocks motor commands for a while, but it does not replace a hardware power switch.
